doc.name: A — artisan bread catalogue, gel lit neon, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: scored sourdough boule
Category: artisan bread
Shot programme: gel lit neon
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are a commercial stills director briefing an artisan bread capture. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the tilted dynamic in a gel lit neon treatment.

SUBJECT. A scored sourdough boule. Product fidelity is non-negotiable: shape, seams, cap, closure, print placement and colour must match the reference precisely. Only the scene around it is yours to author.

CAMERA. Camera rolled into a deliberate tilt with the product on a diagonal. Shoot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/2, framing for dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin. Stage the product on or against washed linen, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
